topic: Imu keeps a large straw hat in a frozen chamber under Pangaea Castle and carries Luffy's wanted poster there, which reads as aiming at Luffy himself
title: Imu Keeps A Straw Hat Frozen Under Pangaea Castle
description: Imu keeps a large straw hat in a frozen chamber under Pangaea Castle and carries Luffy's wanted poster down to it. Add the Room of Flowers, Egghead and Elbaph, and here is why I think the obsession is personal.
comment: Is Imu hunting Luffy himself, or only the ghost of Joy Boy? Pick one.

lines.text: Imu keeps a large straw hat in a frozen chamber under Pangaea Castle.

shot.fallback: frozen chamber holding a large straw hat

lines.text: He even carries Luffy's wanted poster down to it.

shot.fallback: masked ruler holding a wanted poster

lines.text: In the Room of Flowers, he cuts up that same poster, recognizing Luffy as Joy Boy's second coming.

shot.fallback: ruler among white flowers tearing a poster

lines.text: At Egghead, in chapter 1122, he screams in agony at Joy Boy's Haki.
At Elbaph, in chapter 1188, he taunts Luffy that Joy Boy would not have been this weak.

shot.fallback: ruler looming over a pinned pirate

lines.text: Gaban reads it as Imu aiming at Luffy because Luffy reminds him of Joy Boy.

shot.fallback: old giant pirate watching a masked ruler

lines.text: Think about how unfair that is. He measures Luffy against a man who has been gone for 900 years.

shot.fallback: ancient hero silhouette behind a rubber pirate

lines.text: A man doesn't keep a hat in a frozen chamber over a name.
I'd say Imu isn't hunting a pirate. He's hunting a ghost, and Luffy keeps wearing its face.

shot.fallback: masked ruler staring at a grinning pirate

lines.text: So who is paying more for that name, Luffy or the man hunting it?

shot.fallback: rubber pirate facing a masked ruler

lines.text: And that's why I can't stop thinking about the hat...

shot.fallback: large straw hat in a frozen chamber

self_check.hook: line 1 names the character and the claim
